analysis: Reviewed the two head_text units of docs/architecture/inference.md (lines 1217-2025) against the canonical threat model. The only changed range in this PR is head lines 2966-2970, a documentation-only edit. It says the control leader's cluster service re-plans and re-adopts a model only once both Macs report the same worker build (`ClusterOnboardingUpdate.oneBuild`), and it links to the pair's coordinated update. Neither supplied unit contains the changed lines. They show only unchanged surrounding documentation on GLM5Next media, prefix cache, calibration, deadlines and MTP. I saw no code, config, trust-boundary, cryptographic, authorization, attestation or cache-storage change in the supplied evidence. The prose describes no weakened control: T-041 prefix-cache scope, TTL and HMAC naming are untouched, and the App Attest, coordinator and TB-012/TB-013 boundaries are not referenced. The `oneBuild` gate is described as an availability and consistency check, not a security control. Its implementation (`ClusterOnboardingUpdate`, `ClusterService.checkForUpdate`) and the linked cluster-always-on doc were not supplied, so I cannot verify that the doc matches the code, or that cluster peer authentication is unaffected. That is a coverage limit, not a finding. No finding is raised. Integration should check that the cluster update path, if changed elsewhere in the PR, keeps peer authentication and worker-digest validation intact, because the 600 s wait on mismatched builds is only an availability behavior.
